description: Utility functions for user role assignment and contact creation in ERPNext portal module.

methods.name: set_default_role
methods.description: Assigns roles like Customer, Supplier, Student, Guardian based on email and contact links.

methods.name: create_customer_or_supplier
methods.description: Creates a Customer or Supplier document based on default role and user session, linking contact info.

methods.name: create_party_contact
methods.description: Creates a Contact document linked to a party (Customer/Supplier) with email and name.

methods.name: party_exists
methods.description: Checks if a contact exists for a user and if it is linked to a specific doctype.
